.github/**.command: just fast && just check && just score
.github/**.purpose: verify hosted workflow runs the same lanes as local (parity)

AGENTS.md.purpose: verify split metadata and agent maps

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: verify release notes stay routed through the score lane

Justfile.command: just fast && just check && just score
Justfile.purpose: verify the canonical local command wrappers stay reproducible

VERSION.purpose: verify version source stays aligned with release evidence

agent/.purpose: verify agent metadata parses and routes proof lanes

docs/.purpose: verify agent-readable docs remain routed and auditable

generated/**.purpose: verify the generated pin env matches tool-manifest.toml

ops/**.purpose: verify the generator/installer parse and the pin stays consistent

ops/git-hooks/.command: just fast && just check && just score
ops/git-hooks/.purpose: verify the pre-push hook delegates to the local lanes

policy/**.purpose: verify the default fallback policy parses and stays routed

scripts/**.purpose: verify the local CI helper scripts parse and stay reproducible

tool-manifest.toml.purpose: verify every family consumer matches the single source of truth

tools-registry.toml.purpose: verify the reusable-tool registry parses and aggregates for the golden box

tasks/**.purpose: verify build-queue tasks parse and reference registered tools
